description: Capabilities granted to every Caduceus window. Caduceus deliberately does NOT enable the shell, fs or http plugins on the frontend: anything that touches the filesystem, spawns a process or talks to a network endpoint is implemented in Rust and exposed as an explicit #[tauri::command], so the webview can never be tricked into arbitrary execution. NOTE: `windows` is an allow-list and it is opt-in per window — a window missing from it silently loses every permission below, including the ability to receive events at all. Any new window must be added here. NOTE ALSO: the permissions below are the only thing this file scopes. Caduceus's own #[tauri::command]s are not covered by the ACL, so every window listed above can call every one of them — the recorder HUD has the same command surface as the Command Center. Adding a window here is granting it all of them.
